entities.summary: Library of the Lodz University of Technology is a library of the Lodz University of Technology, Łódź, Poland. The library was founded in 1945. It began to offer its services with the collection of 930 volumes and four people of staff. Nowadays the library offers free access to over 250 thousand of books and over 130 thousand of journals, with reading rooms containing hundreds of places to study and over 120 computers for user’s needs and rooms for individual and group study. The Main Library also houses WIKAMP Center as well as an art gallery Biblio-Art.
